text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I brought Gentildonna, who was looking unwell, to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I truly appreciate your concern.
Well then, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...This is...
Unforgivable... unforgivable...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh? Who might that be?

text_block_list.name: Ghost with an Iron Ball
text_block_list.text: I'm the iron ball you crushed.

text_block_list.name: Ghost with an Iron Ball
text_block_list.text:
I will never forgive you!
I'll crush you! Crush you! CRUSH YOU!

text_block_list.name: Ghost with an Iron Ball
text_block_list.text: Iron balls don't usually crush! You just crushed our entire world in your bare hands!

text_block_list.name: Ghost with an Iron Ball
text_block_list.text: Iron balls are hard! Strong! And yet! You crushed our very pride alongside it!

text_block_list.name: Ghost with an Iron Ball
text_block_list.text:
I won't forgive you! I won't! I won't!
I'll crush you! Crush you! Crush you!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Heh. Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A weak body makes for a weak spirit.
No wonder this isn't serving as proper training.

text_block_list.name: Ghost with an Iron Ball
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't want to be crushed!
Then forge yourself hard enough so you won't be!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yet you lot...
rested on the laurels of being born as "Iron Balls,"
and neglected your training.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking they were too big to fail,
they grew arrogant, became lazy, and then—were crushed."

text_block_list.name: Ghost with an Iron Ball
text_block_list.text: T-That's...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Admit it. Acknowledge your own softness and frailty.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Only by crushing that underfoot
can one attain true strength."

text_block_list.name: Ghost with an Iron Ball
text_block_list.text:
! R-Right... I remember now.
I am... We, the "Iron," are—

text_block_list.name: Ghost with an Iron Ball
text_block_list.text:
“—Things that grow stronger by being struck.
Resenting someone like this... won't make you... stronger... at all...—”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...An iron ball, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
Maybe I'll give it a little polish when I get home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rest paid off, and Gentildonna
fully regained her peak condition.
